ValidationRule.description: Amendment Quote require changes to submit for Approval.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Type__c, 'Amendment'), Number_of_Non_Amendment_Quote_Lines__c = 0, OR( ISCHANGED(ApprovalStatus__c), ISCHANGED(Exclusivity__c), ISCHANGED(Termination__c), ISCHANGED(Publicity__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: It looks like you have not made any changes to the current contracted products. Please return to the quote line editor to add or cancel products.
